text_block_list.text: The first day of summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! Taking up your time when you 
must be so busy on the first day of camp!

She had received an enthusiastic offer 
from a young man who ran an UmaTube 
channel called "Weekly Pakatto Channel" 
and was being interviewed by him.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you today!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looking forward to working with you 
too!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
By the way, I watched your channel the 
other day! You really think pretty highly 
of me, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? For real!? Yeah, to be honest, I'm a 
huge fan of C.B.-san!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Today's interview is a dream come true! 
Once again, thank you so much for having 
me today!"

And so, swept along by his sheer passion, 
the interview proceeded smoothly without a 
hitch—

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Races are just a place to run however you 
like... That's such a wonderful, 
CB-san-like way of thinking!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"...And with that, we conclude the 
questions. Thank you very much!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: No, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! This has nothing to do 
with the interview, but... have you ever 
heard a story like this?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: A story like this... what kind of story?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, a bit of a conflict has arisen 
between the younger generation and the 
older generation of racing fans."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Wait, really?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The younger generation says, "Mr. 
C.B. is the one who will forge a new 
myth," and—

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
The older generation says, "She's 
certainly strong, but she can't match that 
myth—the legacy left behind by the Triple 
Crown Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh... What a weird thing to argue about.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Haha. But really, that's just how fans 
are."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
There's no real way to measure who's truly 
stronger. Even knowing that, you can't 
help but believe the Umamusume you've been 
following is number one.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Especially for the younger generation, 
C.B.-san is the first Umamusume they can 
realistically look up to as the strongest 
in history!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
As a fellow newcomer, I have high hopes 
for you too! Do your best, CB-san!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Between the younger and older generations, 
huh? I see. So that kind of world existed.

Even so, to Mr. C.B. herself, races are 
ultimately just a means to run freely.
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it too much, alright?
Don't worry about it too much, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ahaha, you're worried about me?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, I don't care at all. I'm 
just gonna run however I want!"

I breathed a sigh of relief at the casual 
response.
choice_data_list: (Mr. C.B. is strong-willed at her core)

text_block_list.text:
With a newfound appreciation for that... 
this year's summer training camp began.
